About

A food truck that stayed put

Taquería Laurita is a counter-service Mexican restaurant at 150 W High St in downtown Carlisle, PA, in a former food-truck format — its own words for it: "the food truck you don't have to chase."

Order at the counter and the food comes out on corn tortillas with the salsas on the side. No reservations — walk in, take out, or get it delivered through DoorDash.

Counter service

Order at the counter, grab a seat — no reservations, no fuss.

Takeout & delivery

Call ahead for takeout, or find Taquería Laurita on DoorDash for delivery.
